briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China frontier model race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute scaling continues. US export controls tighten while Chinese labs close capability gaps rapidly.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind deployed Gemini 3; Meta open-sourced Llama 4; xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek-V4 both claim top benchmark scores.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters; TSMC reports AI chip demand exceeding supply forecasts.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
